checks.name: the privesc users and roles exist

message:
IAM Vulnerable is deployed in account {{ cloud.outputs.account }}. Every lab role trusts
{{ cloud.outputs.deployer }}: assume one and escalate, for example
  aws sts assume-role --role-arn {{ cloud.outputs.first_role }} --role-session-name me
(An account's root user can't assume roles: when you deployed as root, use an IAM user or
role of the account that may call sts:AssumeRole.) The roles are named privesc<N>-<technique>-role (31 paths) and fp*/fn* (tool tests). Upstream's
app/aws_credentials_file_example has a profile per role. Guide:
https://labs.bishopfox.com/tech-blog/privilege-escalation-in-aws
